notes.title: Update! New Features and OST!
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone, how are you doing? [/b]

I just updated the game with new features and improvements! Motivated by feedback from the community.

I hope that players now have a much better experience when playing!

[b]There is the news:[/b]

[list]
[*] Auto Save partial progress: Now you can leave an unfinished level, and go back to finish it whenever you want!
[*] New soundtrack, original relaxing, now with a song for each stage!
[*] New easier game mode, now with 60 pieces.
[*] Zoom feature on the 2.5D camera that makes the experience much better.
[*] And some more improvements in general art and Gameplay.[/list]

What is your opinion about these changes?
Let me know by commenting on the community center.

Follow the Steam page of RSoft Games to receive all the news about my upcoming games!
Go to

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/RSoftGames/ ]https://store.steampowered.com/developer/RSoftGames/ [/url]

and click the [b]Follow button![/b]
